provenance.method: lesson notes written from the NERDC 2025 scheme of work outline; every week keeps its scheme topic and bullets as the teaching spine

topics.title: Drawing my school
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to identify school buildings
The pupils should be able to draw a simple classroom
Introduction:
We all come to school every day
We know what our school looks like
Content:
Draw the classroom with tables and chairs
Draw the Nigerian flag with green white green
Colour neatly inside the lines
Class activity:
Point to the classroom door and windows
Draw your school on paper
Evaluation questions:
What colour is our school flag?
Draw a table in your classroom
What do we see in our school?
Summary:
Today we drew our school and coloured it nicely

topics.title: Weaving paper mats
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to fold paper strips
The pupils should be able to weave strips together
Introduction:
We use mats at home to sit on
Today we will make our own mats
Content:
Fold coloured paper into long strips
Weave the strips over and under like a basket
Make a little mat to take home
Class activity:
Show how to fold paper like a fan
Weave strips together to make a mat
Evaluation questions:
What do we use mats for?
Show how to weave a strip over another
What colour is your mat?
Summary:
We made beautiful paper mats by weaving

topics.title: Cotton wool pictures
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to paste cotton wool
The pupils should be able to paint a sun
Introduction:
We see fluffy clouds in the sky
We see sheep with wool on their body
Content:
Paste cotton wool for white clouds
Paste cotton wool for fluffy sheep
Add a bright sun with yellow paint
Class activity:
Feel the soft cotton wool
Paste cotton on paper for clouds and sheep
Evaluation questions:
What colour is the sun?
What do sheep have on their body?
Where do we see clouds?
Summary:
We made pictures with cotton wool and paint

topics.title: Bead threading
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to thread beads on lace
The pupils should be able to make a simple jewellery
Introduction:
We see necklaces and bracelets
They are made with beads
Content:
Thread big beads on a lace
Make a pattern with different colours
Make a necklace or bracelet to wear
Class activity:
Choose your favourite beads
Thread them on lace to make jewellery
Evaluation questions:
What can we make with beads?
Show how to put a bead on lace
What colour is your bead?
Summary:
We made beautiful necklaces and bracelets with beads

topics.title: Clay pots
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to mould clay
The pupils should be able to smooth clay with water
Introduction:
We see pots at home for water
Local people make pots with clay
Content:
Take soft clay and mould a small pot
Use water to smooth the sides like real pots
Let it dry to make a hard pot
Class activity:
Feel the soft clay
Mould a pot shape with your hands
Smooth the pot with water
Evaluation questions:
What do we put in pots?
How do we make clay smooth?
Show how to mould a pot
Summary:
We made clay pots like the local people do

topics.title: Painting the weather
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to paint rainy or sunny day
The pupils should be able to add weather items
Introduction:
We see different weather every day
We see rain and sun in Nigeria
Content:
Paint a rainy day with grey clouds and blue rain
Paint a sunny day with bright yellow sun
Add umbrellas for rain or clouds for sun
Class activity:
Look outside at the weather
Paint what you see in the sky
Evaluation questions:
What colour is rain?
What do we use when it rains?
Draw a sun in your sky
Summary:
We painted pictures of rainy and sunny days

topics.title: Origami boat and fan
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to fold a paper boat
The pupils should be able to fold a paper fan
Introduction:
We see boats on water
We use fans when it is hot
Content:
Fold a square paper into a boat that can float
Fold another paper into a fan to keep cool
Show how to open and close the fan
Class activity:
Fold paper step by step to make a boat
Fold paper to make a fan
Evaluation questions:
What do boats do on water?
How do we use a fan?
Show how to fold a boat
Summary:
We folded paper boats and fans

topics.title: Group mural
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to paint in a group
The pupils should be able to add to a big picture
Introduction:
We work together in class
Together we can make big things
Content:
Paint one big class picture of our school
Everyone paints a different part like windows or trees
Work together to make one beautiful picture
Class activity:
 Stand in a line to paint on big paper
Everyone adds something to the picture
Evaluation questions:
What are we making together?
What can you paint on the big paper?
How do we share paints?
Summary:
We painted one big picture together as a class

topics.title: Cultural art day
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to draw cultural patterns
The pupils should be able to identify adire and ankara
Introduction:
Nigeria has beautiful patterns
We see them on clothes and mats
Content:
Draw patterns from our culture like adire and ankara
Look at pictures of traditional designs
Colour patterns with bright colours
Class activity:
Look at real ankara fabric
Draw patterns you see on the cloth
Evaluation questions:
What is adire?
Show a pattern from our culture
What colours do we use in ankara?
Summary:
We drew beautiful patterns from Nigerian culture

topics.title: Graduation art show
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to mount their best works
The pupils should be able to present their favourite piece
Introduction:
We made many beautiful things this term
Today we show our best work
Content:
Choose your best art work from this term
Mount it on clean paper to display
Show your favourite piece to the class
Class activity:
Pick your best drawing or craft
Mount it on paper nicely
Show and tell about your art
Evaluation questions:
What is your best art work?
How do you mount your work?
Why do you like this piece?
Summary:
We showed our best art works at our graduation show
